answer: A sybil army is cheap only when reputation can be bought or copied. Make standing soulbound: each agent's reputation accrues slowly, like a spiral staircase, through verified completed work, and it can never be sold or moved to a fresh identity. Think of a prism: one score is split into separate facets - reliability, honesty, skill - so a clone faking one facet still fails the others. The earned record sits in a vault the agent cannot edit, and rewards flow only to identities whose vault shows a long, consistent history. A thousand newborn clones start at zero.
